description_short: A live stats dashboard for your colony in the browser: product flows, stock runway, electricity, computing, Unity and settlement health.
description_long:
Control Room turns the game's built-in web API into a dashboard you open in a browser on a second screen or another device while you play.

What it shows:
- Overview: electricity, computing, health, Unity and pollution at a glance, and the supplies that run out first.
- Every product: production and consumption over time, stock, where it comes from and where it goes.
- Electricity and computing: production, consumption, capacity and surplus, per building type.
- Settlements: population, housing, health and what raises or lowers it, and unmet needs.
- Unity: generated and spent per category.
- Food, pinned products, comparisons and charts for any period (this month, last month, this year, last year, lifetime).
- Controls: pause, game speed, pinning products, a live camera view and a console for game commands.

How to use it: enable the mod, load your save, run web_api_start in the game console, then open http://127.0.0.1:3073/control-room in a browser.

Network and safety: the mod makes no outside network connections and collects no data. It only adds pages and read-only routes to the game's own local web server (127.0.0.1:3073, started by web_api_start). The dashboard changes your game only when you use its controls. It can be added to and removed from existing saves.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/mdomasevicius/coi-control-room
